skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements
Education Minimum: Not stated in posting.
Required Experience: 1+ year of customer service experience. High-volume phone experience is preferred.
Preferred Experience: High-volume phone experience. Bilingual agents can earn more after passing bilingual assessments.
Required Skills:
• Strong communication, problem-solving, and multitasking skills
• Comfort navigating multiple systems at the same time
• Strong attention to detail and good decision-making, including spotting possible fraud
• Reliable attendance and punctuality
• Ability to manage stress and stay adaptable in a fast, high-volume setting
• A Windows 11 PC, webcam, wired USB headset, and wired internet that meets the posted speeds
Best Fit
This role is ideal for:
• Someone with a year or more of phone customer service who can help several customers at once
• Someone detail-oriented who can look over IDs and selfies and make careful decisions
• Someone who wants part-time hours with benefits and is free on weekends
• Someone with a computer that meets the posted specs and a quiet home workspace
Not a Good Fit for:
• Anyone who can’t be available Friday, Saturday, and Sunday, or can’t offer at least 25 hours a week
• Anyone whose computer doesn’t meet the Windows 11, speed, and ping requirements
• Anyone without childcare or dependent care arranged during working hours
• Anyone who can’t commit to the 90-day training and the 6-month schedule
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process: 1. Application 2. Expect an assessment at the end of the application or directly emailed to you. 3. If assessment is passing, expect a recruiter to reach out via email or text for a phone screen. 4. If phone screen passes you can expect the final interview. Total time to hire from date of application can be anywhere from 3-15 days on average.
Top 10 Resume Keywords:
• High-volume phone customer service
• Identity and document verification
• Fraud awareness
• Inbound and outbound calls
• Multitasking across several systems
• Live chat support
• Attention to detail
• Accurate documentation
• Decision making
• Reliable attendance
4-5 interview questions for this role:
• Tell us about your phone customer service experience and the call volume you handled.
• How do you stay accurate when you’re reviewing information and helping several customers at once?
• Walk us through how you’d handle an ID or selfie that looks suspicious.
• How do you stay calm and focused in a fast, high-volume setting?
• How do you feel about working weekends and holidays and keeping a set schedule for 6 months?
other:
Pay, Shift, Benefits, Background, Drug Test Information, and Career Pathway:

Pay: $16.00/hr starting. Pay can grow to $19.00/hr within 6 to 9 months based on performance and attendance. Eligible bilingual agents may earn $18.00/hr after passing bilingual assessments.

Shift: Part-time. Minimum of 25 hours of availability per week. Must be available Friday, Saturday, and Sunday, with 6 consecutive hours on both Saturday and Sunday. Holiday availability is required, and a schedule commitment is required for the first 6 months. Current priority shifts in Arizona time are 5:00 PM to 11:00 PM, 1:00 PM to 7:00 PM, and 3:00 AM to 9:00 AM (limited need). Arizona time is 1 to 2 hours behind Oklahoma depending on daylight saving time. Training is virtual and instructor-led, followed by hands-on experience and coaching, with a full 90-day training commitment. The current class starts 10/27/2026 and runs 2 weeks, Tuesday, Wednesday, Friday, Saturday, and Sunday, 8:00 AM to 2:00 PM Arizona time. Camera on is required.

Benefits: Part-time benefits including medical, dental, vision, Rx savings, and 401(k).

Equipment Provided: Not provided. Participant supplies a Windows 11 PC (16GB RAM minimum, 32GB recommended, CPU benchmark score of 6,000 minimum, 10,000 recommended), an SSD, a webcam, a wired USB headset, and wired internet with at least 50 Mbps download, 5 Mbps upload, and under 100ms ping. A quiet, distraction-free workspace is required, and virtual backgrounds are not allowed.

Felony Friendly?: Case by case.

Drug Test: Certain positions.

Notes: Apply on the same computer you plan to use for work, because the application includes required compatibility testing and isn’t mobile friendly. The application must include a screenshot of your Computer Specs test results, screenshots of your Facial Recognition Assessment scores, and a completed Criteria Assessments LV 4-part assessment. The posting says to complete all interviews and assessments without AI tools, and using them can get you removed from consideration. Childcare or dependent care must be arranged during working hours. Applications aren’t accepted from CA, CO, CT, MD, MA, NJ, NY, OR, RI, WA, the District of Columbia, or outside the US. Part-time benefits and a path to $19/hr in 6 to 9 months make this a good fit for someone who wants weekend hours.

Career Pathway: Reasonable inferred path: Live Verification Phone Agent → Senior Phone Agent → Team Lead → Customer Service Supervisor.
